summary: Export the GPG key to signing_service.gpg, create secret signing-galaxy from it (key name must be signing_service.gpg), and set spec.hub.signing_secret and signing_scripts_configmap on the AAP CR.
questions: How do I give automation hub my GPG signing key on OpenShift?
What is signing_secret in the hub spec?

answer_card.title: Hub signing key and CR
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
gpg --export --armor <your-gpg-key-id> > signing_service.gpg
oc create secret generic signing-galaxy --from-file=signing_service.gpg
```
```yaml
spec:
  hub:
    signing_secret: "signing-galaxy"
    signing_scripts_configmap: "signing-scripts"
```
